# TARRO AND JOHNSON PARK AMENITIES BUILDINGS

# CONTRACT No. 2026/062T

1. PURPOSE: The City of Newcastle (CN) proposes the construction of sporting amenities blocks and change rooms at both Tarro Oval and Johnson Oval. Works are to achieve compliance with the relevant Australian Standards, Codes of Practice, the National Construction Code, and any other legislative requirements.

2. INVITATION: Persons willing to fulfil the requirements of the proposed contract is invited to submit a tender to the Council by the deadline, 2pm on Tuesday 31 March 2026 (at the Tender Box). Responsibility for lodgement of completed tender documents by the deadline lies solely with the Tenderer. Tender lodgement information is provided in the tender document. Council is not bound to accept the lowest tender or any tender submitted.

3. INFORMATION: All enquiries relating to the Tender must be directed to the nominated Project Officer, Laura Chen, via the online forum at https://app.eprocure.com.au/ncc . Alternatively, you can contact Laura Chen on telephone: (02) 4974 2463 or e-mail lchen@ncc.nsw.gov.au. Any verbal enquiries are to be confirmed in writing.

4. PRE-TENDER MEETING: A non-mandatory pre-tender meeting will be held on Wednesday 11th March 2026 at 9:30am at Johnson Oval Park, 10 Bindera Road, Lambton.

5. TENDERERS TO NOTE: In the preparation and submission of the tender and without limiting the Tenderer’s obligations, the Tenderer shall:

submit a tender which includes all Schedules
